**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744),
We shall have a good Christmas Number.

All I have is excellent, and would nearly suffice
But will you consider whether it would not be better to change the printer of the [Packet](../others.html#52) - [Clowes](../persons.html#309) has never been attentive since it was transferred to them.

You know I have made continual complaints of inattention to directions, and [Miss Coleridge](../persons.html#329) says the same.

Promises of amendment have been made, but without effect, and since the dual editorship, the confusion has been greater[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: In 1890 a new series of the Monthly Packet began, jointly edited by CMY and Christabel Coleridge.

In 1893 CMY retired from the editorship and it appeared in 1894 as ‘edited by Christabel R.

Coleridge and Arthur Innes’.
